method: Reconsidered the 2026–2027 English Economics catalogue structure and individual course evidence, then independently checked the current workbook against the exact frozen decision and record.
findings: The 180 EC route includes named common and Economics courses and 24 EC of restricted electives. The first two years clear both thesis credit thresholds. The selected restricted electives are available in periods 4 and 5 and use the first-listed options in those periods, separate from the open semester.

The strongest broad plan integrates economics, business and methods. The public plan adds comparative legal institutions and applied policy. The finance plan adds quantitative modelling and cross-border trade law. All offerings and prerequisites align with the current workbook.

The comparison shows the distinct causal research laboratory, game theory and compulsory thesis rather than bundling them. Related quantitative and business courses have bounded partial links, and optional independent research is outside the schedule.
